results.title: Business News | Japan Economy Grows 1.1% in April-June, but Energy Disruptions Weigh on Domestic Demand
results.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Japan's economy grew at an annualised 1.1 per cent in April-June, marking a second consecutive quarter of expansion, but fell short of the 2.0 per cent market expectation as the fallout from the West Asia conflict weighed on business investment and household spending, government data showed on Monday.
